candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: RTS unit sprite concept, one isolated character. Reference images: original Disciple warrior and previous Lightness/Magic concept sheet, style/camera/identity references only. Create the melee Dao of Lightness: white and grayscale light cloth for runtime team tinting, black topknot, pale skin hands, thin gently curved katana with clean silver blade and dark hilt, no bow or quiver. Strict orthographic camera directly overhead: show crown, shoulders, forearms and weapon ONLY; NO face, frontal torso, legs or feet. Character faces screen bottom. Match the painted shading, crisp dark outlines and chunky readable RTS forms of references. Full silhouette centered, ample margins, pure solid #ff00ff magenta matte, no shadow, no text, no labels, no motion blur, no glow, no extra objects. A nimble fast melee swordsman clearly different from broad-bladed base Disciple and hooded wide-mantle Magic. Katana thin but clearly readable at small game size. Split-tail duelist: narrow wrapped sleeves, two very long thin headband streamers sweeping back, compact shoulders, katana held one-handed out to the right in an open ready guard. No cape. Distinctive two-ribbon fork silhouette.
